postconditions: Material dropdown shows Window Glass selected

action.code: const opacitySlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')).find(s => s.previousElementSibling?.textContent?.includes('Opacity') || s.id?.includes('opacity')); if(opacitySlider) { opacitySlider.value = 0.85; opacitySlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } const roughnessSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')).find(s => s.previousElementSibling?.textContent?.includes('Roughness') || s.id?.includes('roughness')); if(roughnessSlider) { roughnessSlider.value = 0.25; roughnessSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); }

const select = document.querySelector('select'); const options = Array.from(select.options); const chairFabricOption = options.find(opt => opt.textContent.includes('Chair Fabric') || opt.textContent.includes('Fabric')); if(chairFabricOption) { select.value = chairFabricOption.value; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); }

postconditions: Material dropdown switched to Chair Fabric
selectedMaterialIndex updated to chair fabric index (2)

action.code: const roughnessSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')).find(s => s.previousElementSibling?.textContent?.includes('Roughness') || s.id?.includes('roughness')); if(roughnessSlider) { roughnessSlider.value = 0.4; roughnessSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } setTimeout(() => { const select = document.querySelector('select'); const options = Array.from(select.options); const chairWoodOption = options.find(opt => opt.textContent.includes('Chair Wood') || opt.textContent.includes('Wood')); if(chairWoodOption) { select.value = chairWoodOption.value; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); setTimeout(() => { const envSlider = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]')).find(s => s.previousElementSibling?.textContent?.includes('Env') || s.id?.includes('env')); if(envSlider) { envSlider.value = 3.5; envSlider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); } }, 500); } }, 800);
const select = document.querySelector('select'); select.selectedIndex = 0; select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true}));

postconditions: Material selector cycled back to first option
All material properties maintain restored values
